newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan real estate buoyed by land plan.
newsitem.headline: Japan real estate buoyed by land plan.

text.p: Issues in the real estate sector were higher in Friday morning trade as hopes concerning the government's plan to improve land liquidity continued to buoy the sector, brokers said.
As of 0140 GMT, Mitsubishi Estate Co Ltd shares were 30 yen higher at 1,440, Sumitomo Realty & Development Co Ltd added 28 yen to 885 and Mitsui Fudosan Co Ltd rose 50 yen to 1,360.

"The market wants to see what the government's plans are before buying shares in the real estate sector, but trade is so slow today it's the only sector that looks attractive," a dealer at a second-tier brokerage said.
